label: Bump density from pitch
subgoals: Divide one millimetre by the pitch
Square the result for bumps per square millimetre

label: Power bumps from current limits
subgoals: Divide the die current by the per-bump limit
Double for the ground return and add sharing margin

label: Bump resistance
subgoals: Compute the joint cross-section from its diameter
Convert solder resistivity to ohm micrometres
Divide resistivity times height by area
